story_title: Lina and Adams and the Bedtime Book
title: Lina and Adams and the Bedtime Book 🌙 | Learn Bedtime Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Milo the cat can't sleep! Lina and Adams find a cosy way to help him. 🌙📖🛏️
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: moon, pajamas, lamp, pillow, blanket, book, quiet and dream. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🌙 moon — القمر — la lune
👕 pajamas — البيجامة — le pyjama
💡 lamp — المصباح — la lampe
🛏️ pillow — الوسادة — l'oreiller
🧸 blanket — البطانية / الغطاء — la couverture
📖 book — الكتاب — le livre
🤫 quiet — هادئ — calme / silencieux
💭 dream — حلم — le rêve

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: a calm story for bedtime. Pause after each new word and say it softly together. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة هادئة قبل النوم باللغة الإنجليزية لتعلم كلمات جديدة.
🇫🇷 Une histoire douce en anglais pour le coucher, pour apprendre de nouveaux mots.

lines.text: It is the end of a long, happy day.
Lina, Adams and Milo are playing in the garden.
Look, Adams! The sky is orange and pink.
The day is almost finished. Soon it will be night.
Milo yawns a big yawn. Mmm-yaaaw!
Milo is tired. We are tired too!
Let's go inside and get ready for bed.
Now it is dark outside. Lina points up at the sky.
Adams, look! A big, round, white light in the sky!
That is the moon! It shines at night.
The moon is the big light we see in the night sky.
Say it with me: moon!
Meow! Hello, moon!
Inside, Lina and Adams take off their day clothes.
I put on my blue pajamas with little stars.
And I put on my purple pajamas. They are so soft!
Pajamas are soft clothes we wear to sleep.
Can you say it? Pajamas!
Then they brush their teeth. Now they are ready.
Lina turns off the big light. Click!
But Milo runs under the bed. Meow, meow!
Oh, Milo is scared of the dark!
Don't worry, Milo. I will turn on the little lamp.
Click! A soft, yellow light fills the room.
A lamp is a small light we can put next to the bed. Say it: lamp!
Meow. That is better.
But Milo still cannot sleep. He walks round and round.
Milo, are you okay? What do you need?
Maybe he wants a soft place for his head.
Adams gives Milo a little pillow. It is soft, like a cloud.
A pillow is a soft thing for your head in bed.
Say it with me: pillow!
Meow! So soft!
Brrr. The night is a little cold.
Milo is shaking. He needs something warm.
Here, Milo. You can share my blanket.
Adams puts the blanket over Milo. Now he is cosy.
A blanket is big and warm. We put it on us in bed.
Can you say it? Blanket!
Milo is warm now, but his eyes are still open.
I know! Let's read a story from our book.
Yes! The book about the little boat on the sea.
A book has pages with words and pictures inside.
Let's say it together: book!
Lina opens the book. Milo looks at the pictures.
Lina reads in a soft voice. Adams listens.
Once upon a time, a little boat sailed on the calm sea.
Shh. Let's be quiet now. Milo is getting sleepy.
Quiet means no loud sounds. Just soft and calm.
Say it softly with me: quiet.
The room is quiet. Only the clock says tick, tock.
Milo closes his eyes. He purrs. Purrr, purrr.
Look, Milo is smiling in his sleep!
He is having a dream. Maybe he dreams about fish!
A dream is a little story we see in our sleep.
Can you say it? Dream!
I want to dream about riding the little boat.
Now Lina and Adams lie down too.
Adams, thank you for sharing your blanket with Milo.
And thank you for the lamp and the book, Lina.
When we help each other, everyone feels safe.
They put their heads on their pillows.
They pull up their warm blankets.
Our pajamas are cosy, and the room is quiet.
Outside the window, the moon shines on the garden.
The stars twinkle, one by one.
Inside, the little lamp glows softly.
Milo, Lina and Adams are fast asleep.
Sweet dreams, Milo. Sweet dreams, Lina and Adams.
And sweet dreams to you too, little friend.
Good night!
